prompt: Build for this brief: A public information service; people find reliable guidance quickly. Use Forest and Lemon: page #F8FCF9, text #16362B, accent #357346, secondary surface #F2E64B, text on accent #FFFFFF. Set headings in Young Serif and reading text in Inter; rounded expressive serif heading with neutral text. Composition: Single reading column, left aligned headings, marginal metadata, thin section rules. Use body 20px, heading 28px, line height 1.75, reading measure at most 48ch, gap 32px, content width at most 1440px and item radius 8px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
